items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: Buddy Anderson and Frog were in my band.

ctx.x: And on the side I started right away to gettin' music jobs. In fact, I don't know how they even knew I was in town. When I first got in town, naturally I went over to all those famous places in Missouri. And I saw Herschel (phonetic). And, by the way, he played that track on me. I said right to this day, I can't forget him. It was cold. And as soon as I got in town, I kinda' organized this band. I think I had fifteen pieces in it. Buddy Anderson and Frog were in my band.
What do you mean, you organized a band when you got to town?
